correctness.rationale: All vertices, arcs, degrees and the strong-connectivity paths are explicitly enumerated. The six-state block has determinant 28 and Schur transfer 1/7 [[3,4],[4,3]]; hence the reduced outdegree Laplacian is 4/7 (qI-J), and the directed matrix-tree cofactor is exactly the stated prime-power factor. The BEST theorem gives the factorial factor when the uniquely occurring 0001 edge fixes the rotation. Direct exact arithmetic checks q=2..6 and exhaustive q=2 Euler-tour enumeration corroborate, but do not replace, the general proof.

evidence: The range-size-two language is a proper sublanguage of all four-words and of the onto language for q>2; counting Euler tours is not monotone under restricting edges.

General directed matrix-tree/BEST formulas are methods, not a closed evaluation of the present graph.

originality.rationale: Published restricted-cycle existence results (arXiv:1711.07029, 0808.1309) and deletion-set existence probabilities (arXiv:1908.01116) do not imply the exact labeled-alphabet rotation-class count for the length-four, exactly-two-symbol language. Accessible prior exact length-three two-symbol and complementary length-four support-stratum results have nonidentical edge languages; no stronger enumerator was located by actual mathematical searches. The novelty determination is qualified by unindexed equivalents and dependence on published literature coverage, not by search absence alone.
residual_risks: An unindexed enumeration or a specialized form of an older directed-tree theorem may already evaluate the same graph.

value.rationale: Exact all-alphabet enumeration of a natural range-size-two stratum of four-letter de Bruijn windows, going beyond known existence statements. The six-state pair gadget yields a nontrivial determinant and the structural factor 7^{binom(q-1,2)}. The formula resolves an infinite family with explicit minimum-length witnesses, not a table lookup, renaming, or arbitrary numerical slice.
